# Unverified Multi-file 'only_mutate' Syntax

When the anchor scope covers multiple files, the 'only_mutate' value is set as a comma-joined list of file paths. The code highlights that it is unverified whether mutmut accepts this multi-pattern syntax, and there is a risk that mutmut may ignore additional files rather than failing visibly.
